description: CHANGES ONE cast member into a different character: you pass a new one-line visual description, aicut rewrites the member's stored look from it and draws ONE new portrait (the rest of the roster is untouched). It is the tool for 'make the husband smaller and a white strawberry': NOT `regenerate_cast_portrait` (the SAME character again), nor a new `generate_cast` (it re-authors every member and re-buys every portrait). WHEN: the user wants a member to BE something else. `character_id` is the member's `id` from `generate_cast_portraits` or `list_characters` (kind `cast_member`); a free `generate_cast` draft has no library ids, so re-draft that instead. THE DESCRIPTION: ONE line of plain visual English, WHOLE, not a diff ('a small white strawberry man in a rumpled shirt', never 'the same but smaller'): the stored look is rebuilt from it alone, so fold in what the member already was; under about 500 characters. Do not read the line back: show the RESULT. IT PERSISTS: later episodes cast the NEW character. THE CARD: this call already put the aicut cast card up, each portrait filling in as it generates: do not poll or call `show_generation` (one `get_image` read of `portrait_image_id` if asked). No card (a terminal)? Poll each `generating` member's `portrait_image_id` with `wait_for_generation` (media `image`) and give the urls. AFTER: returns the member with its new `description`, `portrait_image_id`, `portrait_status: "generating"`, `changed` (can be `[]`) and a `report`: RELAY THE `report` as written. `changed: []` means the member ALREADY had exactly this description and a portrait was bought anyway. IF THE PICTURE FAILS OR THE ACCOUNT RUNS OUT (402) THE DESCRIPTION HAS ALREADY CHANGED: the member is the new character wearing its old portrait; say so, and `regenerate_cast_portrait` draws the new look for one portrait's price. Do not re-send this tool (it buys a second picture). A 503 `portrait_not_attached` means the portrait WAS generated and CHARGED but did not attach: call THIS tool again with the quoted `idempotency_key` and the same arguments to re-attach it; a different key, or `regenerate_cast_portrait`, would buy a second one. COST: one standard image at `image_model` (or the platform default portrait model), the same as `regenerate_cast_portrait`; `estimate_only: true` prices it without re-describing anything. THE GO: one change, one named member, one priced ask. SPENDS TOKENS: price with `estimate_only: true`, ask in the SAME message as the price, and wait for a go that names THIS purchase (SPENDING RULES, this server's instructions). IDEMPOTENCY: a reused `idempotency_key` REPLAYS the first job whatever the settings: never reuse one for a new generation (this server's instructions).

character_id.description: The cast member's library id: `id` on a `generate_cast_portraits` member or on a `list_characters` entry of kind `cast_member`.

description.description: What this character looks like NOW: one whole line of plain visual English (see THE DESCRIPTION). Not a diff or an image prompt: anything omitted is lost.

image_model.description: Image model: the member's OWN `image_model` from `generate_cast_portraits` (matches the cast and its price). Omitted, the platform default portrait model is used: maybe a different look and price.

name: describe_cast_member
title: Change what one cast member is (and redraw just them)
